_note: Starter persona library for Product Engineering & R&D systems. Fictional; edit in the app.

personas.name: design engineer
personas.description: Creates and revises parts, assemblies, and drawings in CAD and releases them through PLM.
goals: Reuse existing parts instead of creating new ones
pain_points: Cannot see where a change is stuck

personas.name: eco approver
personas.description: Reviews and approves engineering change orders for technical, cost, and compliance impact.
goals: See complete impact information up front

personas.name: manufacturing engineer
personas.description: Turns released engineering BOMs into manufacturing BOMs and routings at the plant.
goals: Receive BOM changes the same day they release
pain_points: Lag between PLM release and SAP

personas.name: plm administrator
personas.description: Configures and supports the PLM platform, integrations, workflows, and user access.
goals: Keep the platform stable and secure
Detect and fix integration failures fast

personas.name: engineering data steward
personas.description: Owns the quality of part, document, and classification master data for a business unit.
goals: Keep master data complete and consistent
pain_points: No tooling to flag or merge duplicates

personas.name: engineering manager
personas.description: Leads an engineering team and is accountable for delivery, cycle time, and cost.
pain_points: No trend data on change cycle time

personas.name: export compliance officer
personas.description: Ensures ITAR and EAR controlled technical data is classified and only seen by authorized people.
goals: Access granted only to authorized users
